summary: Drones can only enter Colombia through Bogota's El Dorado airport, and you fill in a customs form about how you'll use it. Arriving anywhere else with one risks having it taken.
Morocco bans drones and surveillance gear. They are taken from you at entry, so leave them at home.
Carrying more than USD 10,000 (or the equivalent) in cash, cheques or money orders must be declared when you enter and leave Mexico.
